bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to host a world snow-sculpting championship.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SNOW-SCULPTING CHAMPIONSHIP.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Greater Stillwater Chamber of Commerce Foundation to host a world snow-sculpting championship.
additions: $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Greater Stillwater Chamber of Commerce Foundation to host a world snow-sculpting championship.
